ITEM 1 | Orange-colored pieces, roughly oblong and cylindrical with rounded ends, about 4-6 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, smooth glossy-looking skin with slight variation from bright orange to deeper orange-red, some pieces with a few darker spots, piled in a loose heap covering roughly 40% of a square white plate about 26 cm across, pieces stacked two to three high in the center, no visible sauce or char | 230
ITEM 2 | Small pale yellow-orange rounds and coin-like slices, about 1.5-2.5 cm across and under 1 cm thick, smooth surface, clustered at the right edge of the orange heap, covering about 3% of the plate | 20
ITEM 3 | Tiny green flecks, finely chopped herb-like bits, under 0.5 cm, scattered sparsely around the orange pieces on the white plate, dry-looking, covering under 1% of the plate | 1
